# Zoho Recruit | Product Overview

Zoho Recruit is the ATS and CRM in the Zoho ecology, which provides the HR and recruitment agency versions of the enterprise. The core of the product is to create a unified workspace around staff, recruitment, pay/leave time or talent management, reducing fragmentation tools and manual maintenance.
